articles.summary: Mercantile Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: MBWM) will host a conference call and webcast at 10 a.m. ET on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results. The Company's third quarter 2026 earnings release will be released before markets open on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, and available in the "Investor Relations" section of the Company's website, ir.mercbank.com . Participants may access the live webcast on October 20, 2026, at 10 a.m. ET at ir.mercbank.com . An audio archive will be available on the Mercantile Investor Relations website following the call. About Mercantile Bank Corporation Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Mercantile Bank Corporation is the bank holding company for Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank. Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank provide financial products and services in a professional and personalized manner designed to make banking easier for businesses, individuals, and governmental units.
